headword: {重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}
gloss: heavy spender; big spender; whale (gaming slang)

definitions.explanation: In free-to-play mobile games, players who spend large amounts of money on in-game purchases. From {重|じゅう} (heavy) + {課金|かきん} (in-app charges) + {勢|ぜい} (faction).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}だ。
{重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}は{強|つよ}いキャラをすぐ{手|て}に{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Heavy spenders get powerful characters right away.

examples.japanese: {無課金|むかきん}でも{重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}に{勝|か}てるのがこのゲームの{面白|おもしろ}さだ。
examples.english: Being able to beat heavy spenders even without paying is what makes this game fun.

notes:
Made of {重|じゅう} (heavy) + {課金|かきん} (in-app payment) + {勢|ぜい} (group). Refers to players who pour large sums into a free-to-play game's microtransactions — the equivalent English gaming term is "whale."

REGISTER: Casual slang, used in mobile-gaming communities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重課金勢|じゅうかきんぜい}になる: to become a heavy spender

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無課金|むかきん}: playing without paying — spends no money at all
- {微課金|びかきん}: light spender — pays only small amounts
